Documentation → Reference → Error messages

Error messages

The error and warning messages SATOM shows, with where they appear, what they mean and what to do — sign-in, permissions, appliances, jobs and scheduling, changes, backups and updates, HA and the API.

👤 ForViewerOperatorAdministrator
📍 WhereMessage banners at the top of a page, error pages (403, 404, 500), JSON responses

How messages appear#

Where What it looks like
Message banner A coloured banner at the top of the page after an action. Red = error (danger), amber = warning, blue = information, green = success
Error page A full page for 403 (Access denied), 404 (Page not found) and 500 (Something went wrong)
JSON Pages that fetch data get {"ok": false, "error": "…"}; the REST API uses {"error": "<code>", "message": "…"}

Text in angle brackets (<name>) stands for a value filled in at run time.

💡Tip — Error reference

The 500 page shows an Error reference (8 characters). The same reference is written to the audit log and to /opt/satom/data/logs/satom.log, so an administrator can find the exact failure with grep <reference> /opt/satom/data/logs/satom.log.

Sign-in and session#

Message Where Meaning What to do
Invalid username or password. Sign-in Wrong credentials (local or directory) Retry; after 10 consecutive failures the account locks
Too many failed attempts — account temporarily locked. Try again later. Sign-in 10 consecutive failures; locked 15 minutes Wait 15 minutes, or an administrator runs sudo satom execute admin unlock <username>
This account is disabled. Sign-in The user is disabled Ask an administrator to enable it
Your account was imported from the directory but is still awaiting administrator approval. Sign-in Directory user not approved yet Ask an administrator to approve it in Users
Please log in to access this page. Sign-in Session missing or expired Sign in again
Your session was locked after minutes of inactivity. Sign-in page, after any click The browser session was idle for longer than Settings → General → Session Lock (minutes); scripts get HTTP 401 with the same text Sign in again; an administrator can change the timeout (5–1440 minutes)
Your session expired or the form was stale — please try again. Any form The CSRF token is missing or older than one hour, or the proxy dropped the port from Host Submit again; if it repeats on every form, see Troubleshooting
This SATOM is served over plain HTTP while its session cookies are marked Secure… Sign-in The node was reached over http://, so the browser never sends the session cookie Use https://; restore the TLS proxy
Invalid authentication code. 2FA step Wrong or expired TOTP code Check the device clock; use a backup code
Backup code accepted. backup code(s) left. 2FA step Signed in with a one-time backup code Generate new codes when running low
This password-reset link is invalid or has expired. Password reset The link is wrong, used or too old Request a new link
The password must be at least 12 characters. / The password must be at most 1024 characters. / Passwords do not match. Password reset, Settings → Change Password, Add User, administrator reset Validation: one rule (12 to 1024 characters, length only) on every password path, including the CLI and the installers Correct and resubmit
Current password is incorrect. Change password Wrong current password Retype it
429 Too Many Requests Sign-in, 2FA, password reset Rate limit: 5 sign-in attempts per minute per address (2FA 10/min; recovery 5 or 10 per 15 min) Wait a minute

ℹ️Note

Changed in 2.11.0: every password path (Change Password, Add User, administrator reset, reset link, CLI, installers) applies the same 12-character minimum and the same message, and an idle session is now signed out after the Session Lock time.

Permissions and access#

Message Where Meaning What to do
Access denied — You don't have permission to view this page. 403 page Your profile lacks the permission (every page that shows device content needs a read permission too — for example the Audit Log, appliances, FortiWeb protection pages, monitoring, Sentinel and the API consoles), or your address is not in the IP allow-list. The sidebar only shows links you can open, so this usually comes from a bookmark or a shared link Ask an administrator; see Permissions
{"ok": false, "error": "Forbidden"} JSON (HTTP 403) Same, for a background request Same
Page not found — The page you are looking for doesn't exist or has moved. 404 page Wrong URL, or the object belongs to an ADOM or maintenance appliance you cannot see Check the ADOM you are in
503 Service Unavailable Any page (non-administrators) The IP allow-list setting cannot be read, so SATOM refuses rather than admit everyone An administrator fixes Settings → Access Control
Firmware, the backup vault and the console act on the whole appliance, not on — they live on . Appliance pages You opened an ADOM row of a multi-ADOM FortiWeb Use the named appliance row
Refused: that change would remove the last administrator (no remaining user could manage users AND profiles). Users, Profiles The change would leave nobody able to administer SATOM Keep at least one active administrator
You cannot delete your own account. / You cannot change your own account status. Users Self-protection Ask another administrator
Cannot delete the last remaining administrator. / Cannot disable the last remaining administrator. Users Anti-lockout Create another administrator first
System profiles are managed automatically and cannot be edited. Profiles readonly, operator and admin are built in Clone and edit a copy
“” is assigned to user(s). Reassign them first. Profiles Deleting a profile in use Move the users to another profile
Directory accounts manage MFA at the directory. Settings → Security 2FA in SATOM is for local accounts only Configure MFA in your directory
{"error": "registry.execute_write permission required"} Internal appliance proxy (/api/fw/…/proxy/…, /api/adc/…/proxy/…), HTTP 403 A raw POST/PUT/DELETE needs registry.execute_write, as in the API Explorer Use GET, or ask an administrator

Appliances and connectivity#

Message Where Meaning What to do
Name and host are required. Add appliance Required fields empty Fill them in
Appliance name '' already exists. Add appliance Names are unique Choose another name
This ADOM can only add appliances. Add appliance You are in another product's ADOM Switch to the right ADOM
A VIP-mode cluster needs the shared VIP address. Add appliance VIP cluster without VIP Enter the VIP
Cannot connect to : Configuration restore SATOM could not open a session Check reachability and credentials (Appliances)
Could not fetch a backup from : . You can upload a .conf manually instead. Restore The live backup failed Upload a .conf file
Choose a .conf configuration file to upload into the vault. / The uploaded file is empty. Backups No or empty file Choose a valid file
Stored backup unreadable: Backups The stored file cannot be read Take a new backup
This action is only available for FortiWeb appliances. Appliance actions Not supported for this product —
Pick an appliance first. / No commands were entered. Operator console Missing input Select an appliance and enter commands

Firmware and upgrades#

Message Where Meaning What to do
Select a compatible firmware image from the repository first. Upgrade No image selected Upload or select an image in Firmware
Live upgrade requires typing the exact appliance name to confirm. Upgrade Confirmation missing Type the appliance name
Live upgrade refused — change control: . Run the upgrade preparation, raise a change request from it, get it approved, and flash inside its window. Upgrade No approved change request covers this appliance now (for example no approved change request names this appliance for upgrade) Follow Upgrade flow
Firmware file problem: / Upgrade failed: Upgrade The image or the upgrade call failed Check the image and the appliance
The scheduled time must be in the future (). Scheduled upgrade Time in the past Pick a later time
Your session expired — please reload and try again. Firmware upload CSRF token invalid on the upload Reload the page
Upload failed: Firmware upload Storage or validation failure Check disk space and the file
Turn on Path Diagnostics in Settings → Path Diagnostics to see the Upgrade Advisory. Upgrade, Upgrade Flow, Release Notes The Upgrade Advisory follows the Path Diagnostics switch, which is off An administrator switches on Path Diagnostics (see Path Diagnostics settings)

Jobs and scheduling#

Message Where Meaning What to do
Orphaned — the service restarted while this job was running. Job Manager The process running the job ended Check the device state and run the action again
Queued — waiting for “” on this device Job progress Another write to the same appliance is running Wait; it starts automatically
Gave up after 1800 s waiting for another action on this device to finish. Job The device lock was not released in time Check the other job; retry
This action is already running — try again shortly. Scheduled Actions → Run A run holds the lease Wait for it to finish
A name is required. / Select a valid action from the catalog. Scheduled Actions Validation Correct the form
That action does not apply to this ADOM. Scheduled Actions Wrong ADOM for this action Switch ADOM
“” is a action. Create it on . Scheduled Actions Admin and user actions live on different pages Use the named page
Advanced params were not valid JSON and were ignored. Scheduled Actions Bad JSON Fix the JSON
: refused - this action runs only bound to an approved change request inside its window. Run summary (skipped) Destructive action without a change request Run it through a change request
change request: Run summary (skipped) The bound change request is not runnable now (not approved or outside its window) Check the change request
change request #N authorizes 'X', not 'Y' Run summary (skipped) The row is bound to a change request for another action; the change is left untouched Run the action through a change request of that type
change request #N does not cover device id(s) … Run summary (skipped) The row targets devices the bound change request does not name; the change is left untouched Use a change request that names those devices
change request #N authorizes named devices; this action targets the whole fleet Run summary (skipped) The row has no targets (whole fleet) but the bound change request names devices; the change is left untouched Use a change request that names the devices, and let its Schedule button create the row

Changes and templates#

Message Where Meaning What to do
This change request is and can no longer be edited. Change requests Completed, failed or cancelled Create a new change request
approve the change request before scheduling it Change requests → Schedule Not approved Approve first
name at least one appliance before scheduling: an automated change runs only against the devices it names Change requests → Schedule The change names no appliance; it can be saved and read, not scheduled Edit the change and select its affected devices
Only a draft change request can be approved; this one is . Nothing was changed. Change requests → Approve The change request is already approved, scheduled, in progress or finished Nothing to do; to repeat a finished change, create a new change request
This change request is already and cannot be cancelled. Nothing was changed. Change requests → Cancel The change request is completed, failed or already cancelled; its outcome is kept Nothing to do
set a maintenance-window start first Change requests → Schedule No window Set the window
No maintenance window was opened: . Change requests → NetBox The integration refused Check the integration settings
Select at least one device to apply to. Templates No target Select devices
Template not found or locked. Templates Locked (curated) template Clone it
Could not save template: Templates Validation or database error Correct and retry
This object is locked by another user. Take over the lock first. Object editors Someone else holds the edit lease Wait two minutes or take over the lock (Locks)

Backup, restore and updates#

Message Where Meaning What to do
Backup failed: System Backup pg_dump or packaging failed Check disk space and the detail
Restore not confirmed — type RESTORE to proceed. System Backup Confirmation missing Type RESTORE
Restore failed: System Backup pg_restore failed Read the detail; a safety dump was taken first
This node is the standby — delete bundles on the primary; the datasync mirrors the deletion here within 5 minutes. System Backup Standby files are a mirror Act on the primary
Blocked by the staged-rollout safeguard: update the STANDBY to this revision and let it pass its health check first, then the PRIMARY unlocks. Software Update Primary updated before the standby Update the standby first
Upload rejected: Software Update Wrong package name, empty or larger than 400 MB See Offline updates
Refused: this package still fails preflight (). Nothing was applied. Software Update Blocking preflight checks Fix the named checks
This package is OLDER than the running version. Tick the downgrade confirmation to proceed — migrations are not reversed, so keep the database backup. Software Update Downgrade without confirmation Tick the confirmation, or use a newer package
API pack upload rejected: Software Update Invalid API pack See API library
this pack is not signed by a trusted key ( key(s) tried). A pack signed with another lane's key or with the release key is refused. Software Update, satom execute apipack import A 3.0 pack whose signature matches no key of its lane Compare the fingerprint; see Pack trust
pack needs SATOM or newer; this node runs . Update SATOM first, then import the pack again. Nothing was imported. Software Update, console The pack's minimum SATOM version is newer than the node Update SATOM first
pack key directory is not safe to use: Software Update, console /etc/satom/pack-keys/<lane>/ is writable by a non-root account Fix its ownership and mode
This node is the STANDBY: its database is read-only. Knowledge packs are fetched and imported on the PRIMARY and arrive here by replication. Software Update → Knowledge packs Knowledge actions on a standby Use the primary; see Knowledge packs
Knowledge settings not saved: the feed URL must be https:// Software Update → Knowledge packs A non-HTTPS feed URL Enter an https:// URL or leave it empty
No release notes for this build in the local corpus — import a newer knowledge pack (Software Update → Knowledge packs). Release Notes window No imported pack covers that build Import the newest knowledge pack; see Release notes

High availability#

Message Where Meaning What to do
This node is not a standby — promotion is only valid on the node currently in recovery. High Availability Promote pressed on a primary Promote only the standby
Confirmation failed: type this node's hostname () exactly to promote it. High Availability Wrong confirmation Type the host name
The deployment mode is stored in the replicated settings — change it on the PRIMARY node (this node's database is read-only). High Availability Edited on the standby Change it on the primary
Cannot remove this node (self) from the HA registry. High Availability Self-removal Remove it from the other node
peer TLS refused for : peer TLS certificate did not verify against the system trust store or the internal CA (…) — request refused. … Service log The peer's node certificate is not trusted; peer requests are refused instead of sent unverified Install a trusted certificate on the peer (Node TLS); SATOM_PEER_TLS_ALLOW_UNVERIFIED=1 is a temporary override only
bad node key (403) Peer endpoints The peer request's signature is missing, wrong or more than 120 s old Synchronise both clocks (NTP) and run the same release on both nodes

Settings#

Message Where Meaning What to do
Failed to save settings: Settings Validation or database error Correct and retry
Skipped invalid IP/CIDR(s): Settings → Access Control Entries that are not addresses or networks Fix the entries
The '' ADOM still has registered appliance(s) and cannot be deleted — move or de-register them first, or deactivate the ADOM instead. Settings → ADOMs ADOM in use Move appliances or deactivate
The '' ADOM is a core product and cannot be deleted — deactivate it instead. Settings → ADOMs Built-in ADOM Deactivate it
Postgres SSL tuning is not available in the container runtime; set it on the database service. Settings → Node TLS → Apply protocol & ciphers Container installs have no privileged updater to apply it Configure TLS on the PostgreSQL container

API Explorer#

Message Meaning What to do
The "Execute write API calls" permission is required for non-GET methods. You lack registry.execute_write Use GET or ask an administrator
Refused: does not serve / on . Send again with confirm_unserved to override. The API library says this build does not serve the endpoint Confirm only if you are sure
Unverified: — the appliance decides. No evidence for this build or endpoint The request is sent anyway
Appliance host is not permitted. Loopback or link-local appliance address Fix the appliance address

REST API#

The token API returns machine-readable codes such as unauthenticated, invalid_token, insufficient_scope, owner_forbidden, capability_denied, destructive_blocked, rate_limited. The full table is in REST API v1.

Start-up errors (service log)#

Message Meaning What to do
SQLALCHEMY_DATABASE_URI is required in production (set it in /opt/satom/.env); refusing to fall back to SQLite. FLASK_ENV=production without a database URL Restore .env
FERNET_KEY is not set. Refusing to start with an ephemeral key… .env lacks the encryption key Restore the original FERNET_KEY — a new one cannot decrypt stored credentials

Check with journalctl -u satom -n 50 or /var/log/satom/error.log.

action.Scheduled actions (Automations and System Automations)Schedule work to run unattended — fleet changes an operator plans (Automations) and the product's own housekeeping such as backups, syncs bundles, device-config versions, code rollback, git repository bundles and the external backup server — from one admin page.Software UpdateUpdate SATOM's own code and Python dependencies — from the git remote or from a signed offline package — through a privileged runner, standby first on a pair.Offline update packagesUpdate a node with no route to the code repository — a signed package with the application and the Python wheels it may be missing, verified against a root-owned trust store and applied by the privileged runner with automatic rollback.High AvailabilityRun SATOM as a primary/standby pair — see both nodes and their replication live, register the peer, switch between HA and standalone mode, and fail over by hand.
